specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Multi-Device Connection, Power-Saving, Rechargeable, Round Key, Tablet Holder

features: 【🔗 Triple-Mode Wireless Connectivity】 Acer OrbitKeys supports 2.4GHz wireless connectivity along with two Bluetooth channels (BT1 + BT2), enabling flexible wireless connection across compatible devices with a transmission distance of up to 10 m.

【🖥️ Broad Device Compatibility】 Designed for use with compatible desktops, laptops, smartphones and tablets, the Acer OrbitKeys keyboard and mouse set provides flexible connectivity for work, study and everyday computing needs.
【📟 Digital Display Keyboard】 Stay informed with the keyboard’s integrated digital display, designed to show battery and connection status for quick visibility while using the keyboard.

【📱 Built-In Device Holder】 The keyboard features an integrated slot designed to securely hold compatible mobile phones and tablets measuring under 9 inches, keeping your device conveniently positioned while you type.

【🔋 Rechargeable Keyboard & Mouse】 Equipped with a 400mAh rechargeable keyboard battery and 500mAh rechargeable mouse battery, the set supports USB Type-C charging. The mouse also features 3-level DPI adjustment for different work and entertainment needs.
